div.head: CHn cor 9
div.ab: Murdra etiam retro ab illa die qua in regem coronatus fui omnia condono; et ea quæ amodo facta fuerint iuste emendentur secundum lagam regis Eadwardi.
Murdra etiam retro ab illa die qua in regem coronatus fui omnia condono; et ea quae amodo facta fuerint iuste emendentur secundum lagam regis Edwardi.

I likewise remit all murder fines incurred before the day on which I was crowned king, and for those which have been committed since then amends shall duly be made in accordance with the law of King Edward.

note.seg: so Sc 2 Alb; Æd. M; Ed. übr.
thus Sc 2 Alb; Æd. M; Ed. the rest
De confirmatione legum Edwardi regis [vgl. 13] überschreibt Sc; nur deshalb begannen hier c. 2 frühere Edd. der Leges Henrici
De confirmatione legum Edwardi regis [cf. 13] is the heading in Sc; it was only for this reason that earlier edd. of the Leges Henrici began c. 2 here
Vgl. Gl Murdrum 3; Wilhelm I. 4e. 7. [Kein Argument für Bestehen unter Cnut; gegen Stubbs Lect. 118; MacKechnie Magna carta{2} 99]
Cf. Gl Murdrum 3; Wilhelm I. 4e. 7. [No argument for its existence under Cnut; against Stubbs Lect. 118; MacKechnie Magna carta{2} 99]

Regelmässiges Latein hätte hac ‘heute’ gesagt. Die Krönung (s. d. Gl 8a) macht Epoche; über Früheres ergeht Amnestie auch o. 6, u. 14. Öfter steht mlat. fui für sum, wie fuero für ero, auch retinui für retineo 10

Regular Latin would have said hac ‘today’. The coronation (see that word in Gl 8a) marks an epoch; an amnesty for earlier matters is also issued above 6, below 14. Medieval Latin often has fui for sum, as fuero for ero, and also retinui for retineo 10

Nicht die sog. Leges Edw. Conf. werden hiermit zitiert: die sind ein Menschenalter jünger; gegen Price Anc. laws 267. Vielleicht will Heinrich das Odium des Murdrum der Zeit vór seinem Vater zuwälzen, wie drei Menschenalter später der Fälscher des Ps Cn for o. I 620 das des Forstrechts

It is not the so-called Leges Edw. Conf. that are cited here: they are a generation later; against Price Anc. laws 267. Perhaps Henry wishes to shift the odium of the murdrum on to the time before his father, as three generations later the forger of Ps Cn for above I 620 does that of the forest law
